title: Run section
description: The run section of an agentic.json file: the agent and provider of a sandboxed run, its isolation, provision and network axes, what the sandbox may reach, and the guarantees the run requires.

models.description: Model slot overrides of the provider, as slot=id.

image.description: The container image of a docker or openshell run, which holds the agent unless the provision supplies it. Both isolations need one: agent-cli ships no image.

customEnv.description: Environment variables of the sandbox, as KEY=VALUE.

credentials.description: Credential bindings, as NAME=scheme:locator. A file holds where a credential is, never its value.
